summary_rationale: Protean eGov Technologies combines a near-monopoly CRA pension recordkeeping franchise (97% market share, 9.39 Cr subscribers) and a debt-free balance sheet (>Rs 800 Cr cash) with significant structural headwinds: the August 2025 loss of the Rs 792 Cr PAN 2.0 backend tender to LTIMindtree puts ~50% of revenue (Tax Services, Rs 498 Cr) at post-FY27 transition risk; operating margins have compressed from 23% (FY19) to 10-12% (FY24-TTM) amid rising RFP/capex intensity (fixed assets + CWIP up to Rs 325 Cr by Sep 2026); FY26 free cash flow fell to Rs 12 Cr on Rs 66 Cr capex and 75-93 debtor days; and consolidated ROE sits at 10.0% with 52% of FY26 PBT derived from treasury other income.
